notes:
Connection: when the licence server cannot be reached, the Companion now says so on the Account page instead of sitting there licensed and doing nothing, and it tries a second route to reach it by itself. Some networks block the first route outright, and that one blocked route made the game look like it could not see the Companion and hid multi client at the same time. Both are fixed.

Multi client: Stop all AUTO stops every client that is running, and answers you when none is. A second client started from the top bar or the master hotkey no longer starts farming by itself after the Companion is reopened or updated. A leftover Sandboxie box is reused instead of refusing to add a client, a restart prepares the box again so a client always lands on its own port, and recovery names the box when one stops answering. A client whose licence is refused now shows the reason on its card.

Recovery: the first client remembers whether you had AUTO on, so a crash during a GM pause or a scheduled AFK phase comes back farming. A licence re check that cannot run keeps the state you had and retries, instead of closing every second client until you restart. Every probe the app makes now gives up after ten seconds rather than freezing the window.

Farming: a sell trip that keeps failing while overweight gives up cleanly and turns AUTO off, a death during a sell or storage errand resets it instead of leaving it half done, a refused town warp is tried again while you are still low, and the channel hop no longer fires on the first tick after a pause.

Support: a support bundle is named after the client it came from, so exporting one per client gives you two files instead of two copies of the same name.
